titulo: ‘This is terrorism’: daytime Russian strike hits science academy in Kyiv
cuerpo: Jet-powered drones are increasingly targeting Ukraine’s capital, with medical centre also hit A Russian drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, killing at least one person, in the latest daytime attack on Ukraine’s capital. Flames tore through the historic building as people clambered out of first- and second-floor windows to escape, in dramatic scenes increasingly familiar in the heavily bombarded city.
